payload.summary: Forms PDF manifest asserts a 17 July 2026 generation date with no re-fetch of the original bytes
payload.detail: data/forms-pdf-manifest.json generatedAt is 2026-07-17, and repository-providers.ts derives both the Forms source version and its reviewDate from that date. No original PDF bytes have been re-fetched or compared since. That makes the provider's 'locally_reviewed' status an assurance about the manifest, not about the current published asset. Resolution is an approved fetch of the 51 official PDFs, a digest comparison against the recorded sha256, and regeneration through scripts/build-forms-pdf-manifest.mjs - never a cosmetic date advance. Package hold H04/H10.
